garden.hint.named: Decided by nine cells — the eight around it and itself. Nobody touches it.
garden.hint.wild: Nobody has named this rule. What happens today, nobody knows.
garden.line.today: Today’s rule is {rule} ({code}). The seeds are down; nobody touches it now.
garden.event.extinct: By generation {gen}, no one was left.
garden.event.frozen: Nothing has changed since generation {gen}. It set.
garden.event.cycle: It returns to the same shape every {v} generations. Like breathing.
garden.event.bloom: At generation {gen} it suddenly grew {v}× larger.
garden.event.drift: Generation {gen} — something is drifting to one side.
garden.event.steady: {gen} generations in, and no one has died.
garden.event.noise: Generation {gen} — the shapes have scattered. From here it is just noise.
garden.event.crowded: Generation {gen} — the board is full. Nowhere left to grow.
garden.dex.title: {n} kinds found
garden.dex.osc: {n} cells · returns to itself every {p} generations
